description: AstroLogic is a team of young innovators passionate about space exploration, artificial intelligence, programming, and technology. We aim to transform creative ideas into smart solutions using science and innovation. We welcome motivated people who enjoy teamwork, problem-solving, coding, AI, and exploring new possibilities. Let’s think beyond limits and create something extraordinary together!
summary:
AstroVitals is an advanced Deep-Space Astronaut Health and Bio-Digital Twin platform designed for extreme lunar and Mars missions. Operating entirely offline to overcome Earth-communication blackouts, it serves as an autonomous life-support engine based on 10 critical engineering constraints.
The system features a dynamic Kalman Filter to clean real-time ECG telemetry by rejecting motion artifacts, such as drilling vibrations. To ensure data integrity against cosmic radiation, it employs Triple Modular Redundancy, automatically detecting and repairing memory bit-flip errors. Mission telemetry is strictly secured using AES-256-GCM encryption and anti-replay protection. Furthermore, an Autonomous Triage Matrix evaluates the 4-person crew in real-time, categorizing them into deterministic priority levels to efficiently allocate emergency oxygen and resources.
Visually, this complex backend architecture is represented through a highly responsive React frontend simulator. The UI utilizes a high-contrast cyber-dark theme, featuring live kardiogram charts, half-moon gauge sensors, and a zero-latency emergency override protocol, ensuring maximum visibility and rapid response capabilities for astronauts in the harshest deep-space environment
